identity_reason: it is Stepper, the step panels and Buttons, so only the heading that takes focus and the order of actions are its own
concept: A task in steps: Stepper on top, one panel at a time under a heading that takes focus, Back and Next with the loud one last.

root.why: the Stepper, the panel and the actions stack at the section rhythm

panel.why: each panel stacks its fields at the field rhythm and stays in the page when hidden

title.why: the step heading takes focus when the step changes so the reader hears where they are

count.why: the step count sits above the heading in the secondary tone

actions.why: the actions sit at the end with the loud button last

cancel.why: Cancel sits apart at the start so it is never pressed for Back

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the part is reached by keyboard
